extracted.name: Balsamic Vinegar and Olive Oil Dressing
extracted.description: A light, spiced dressing with a bit of thyme and oregano sprinkled in. This is a great excuse to buy a big bottle of balsamic vinegar. Makes one beautiful cupful.
instruction_lines: In a medium glass mixing bowl combine the oregano, thyme, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Mix together and pour mixture into a bottle, using a funnel to keep yourself from losing oil. Cover tightly and store at room temperature.
